Looking For More Information? Check out the answers of all the relevant Power BI Dashboards queries you might have. What is Power BI Dashboard? Power BI dashboard is a one page visual representation that displays the most important metrics and insights in one page. It combines relevant indicators of various reports in order to offer a clear picture of the business performance. What is the difference between the dashboard and the report? The dashboards are tailored to the high-levels of monitoring and decision support, while the reports are designed for more deeper analysis with multiple pages, filters and interactive exploration. Can dashboards show real-time data? Yes, dashboards may appear close to real-time or live data when connected to streaming resources, DirectQuery models, and frequently refreshed data sets. Does Power BI combine data from multiple sources? A single view includes visuals that are sourced by ERP, CRM, finance platforms, cloud services and other enterprise systems providing a unified view. Are dashboards interactive? Dashboards support light interactions. By clicking on a visual, a user can access a detailed report, apply filters, drill down, and explore trends. How often does data refresh? The frequency of refresh is determined by source and configuration of the data. Visuals are automatically updated when underlying datasets are refreshed or new data is added. How access and security are handled? Role-based permissions provide control over access, so the user only sees information relevant to their duties. Can Power BI dashboards be viewed on mobile devices? Yes, they are optimized for mobile viewing and can be accessed using dedicated mobile applications having responsive layouts.
